claim.quote: The excluded area covers a wide range of the sterile neutrino parameters up to $\sin^22\theta_{14}<0.01$ in the most sensitive region.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published Phys. Lett. B 787 (2018) 56-63.

key_value_text.quote: Results are based on 966 thousand antineutrino events collected at 3 distances from the reactor core.
key_value_text.value: Excluded area reaches sin^2(2 theta_14) < 0.01 in the most sensitive region (966 thousand antineutrino events at 3 distances)

name: Search for sterile neutrinos at the DANSS experiment

summary.plain: DANSS compared antineutrino spectra recorded at three distances from an industrial reactor and found no sign of a sterile neutrino. Using 966 thousand events it excluded a wide range of mixing strengths, down to a mixing parameter below 0.01 where it is most sensitive.
summary.technical: Ratio of positron energy spectra at 10.7, 11.7 and 12.7 m (independent of reactor flux shape/normalisation and detector efficiency) from 966 k antineutrino events: 4-neutrino-model exclusion area reaching sin^2(2 theta_14) < 0.01.

title: Search for sterile neutrinos at the DANSS experiment
why_it_matters: A flux-model-independent test of the sterile-neutrino explanation of the reactor antineutrino anomaly at a commercial reactor.
